description: This file implements the ClientsPage component, a React front-end page for managing client records in a CRM application. It includes functionality for listing, searching, paginating, creating, editing, and deleting clients, interfacing with backend API services.

methods.name: paginate(items, page, pageSize)
methods.description: Utility function to paginate an array of items based on the current page and page size.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of clients from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Initializes the form for creating a new client and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Loads selected client data into the form for editing and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the client create/edit modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates the form, performs optimistic UI update, and calls the API to save client data.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a client record, updates UI optimistically, and handles errors.
